detailed_findings.finding: Argument is logically sufficient and aligned with the stated comparison lemma.

reason: The proof directly matches the lemma statement: define a = floor(n t), use a/n <= t, apply monotonicity of floor to each term floor(k·a/n) <= floor(k t), sum after dividing by positive k, and conclude E_n(t) <= E_n(a/n). No missing case or logical gap is apparent.
